_README: Re-adjudication of every active con_copy heal against the PRIMARY RECORD (BSE announcement
stream, runbook §58 rung 3), 2026-08-09, at the user's request. The trigger: only ONE of the 18
heals had ever been independently checkable (against a cached XBRL) and that one -- TATACOFFEE
-- was wrong. So all 17 remaining were re-read from the filings.
RESULT: 12 confirmed, 2 corrected, 2 escalated, 1 pair left alone as immaterial.
With TATACOFFEE that is 4 wrong of 18 (22%), and EVERY failure is the same family --
the heal took a number that was not the one our convention stores:
* TOTAL PAT written where we store OWNERS-attributable   (TATACOFFEE, ATUL, KIRLFER)
* a RESTATED comparative written where we store AS-REPORTED (ACUTAAS)
Root cause was in read_con_copies: it anchored on screener (which quotes TOTAL PAT) and wrote
whichever row matched. Fixed 2026-08-09 -- screener now only locates the COLUMN and the value
is read off the OWNERS row.
METHOD NOTE, because it nearly went wrong again: the first pass at automatic column placement
assumed columns step one quarter per column. Real statements print [current Q, preceding Q,
YEAR-AGO Q, YTD, FY], so it mis-placed almost everything -- it 'corrected' AADHARHFC to its own
YTD columns (1221.97, 1895.02). Those verdicts were discarded and every cell was adjudicated by
hand off an evidence dump. Do not re-automate this without solving column placement properly.
